what_this_is: The public machine-readable entry point for a proof-before-access AI contractor beta.

offer.what: Apply to test one bounded AI workflow for seven days. The job-specific AI is built JIT, run on synthetic equivalents, and delivered as a static HTML proof before any customer-system access is requested.

capabilities_you_may_use: read this document and the rental contract
help a human select a service lane
submit an application only on an explicit human request
exclude secrets, customer data, regulated data, and confidential documents
this_twin_will_never: request credentials or customer-system access before synthetic proof
accept payment through the public agent document
send an application without explicit human approval
